     - Verification: `verified != ""` (+200).

   - [`Engine`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L14-L20) with constructor and functional options (`WithBudgets`, `WithScopeResolver`, `WithProjector`).
   - Query methods: [`TaskStartEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L119-L164), [`DossierEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L166-L182), [`AnchorEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L184-L205), [`ErrorEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L221-L242), and [`GateEntries`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/delivery/engine.go#L255-L292).
